Emma — thanks for sending. Looping in Legal (Laura) and Contracts (Ben) to review the redline. Quick flag from my side after skimming the doc:

- SCCs: most of your edits are standard and we can align, but the new Annex on subprocessors will need to map to our subprocessor list and cadence for updates (we can accept a 30-day notice + monthly published list).
- Transfer addendum: ClearWave's onshore-only routes language is more restrictive than our standard fallback. We need to evaluate operational impact (there may be a capacity/pricing implication for Dedicated/Private).
- Audit & evidence: your redline expands the audit scope to unrestricted audits. We typically offer scoped audits or portal evidence plus a technical witness approach.
- KMS/BYOK: engineering says BYOK is available on Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted requires managed KMS with CEK options.

Laura/Ben — can you review and propose edits? Target: coordinated response to ClearWave by end of day 31 May. Ben, can you run a quick pricing delta for the onshore-only route scenario and note any procurement gating items?

I'll prepare a concise summary we can send to Emma.

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

David / team — reviewed ClearWave_DPA_redline_v1.docx. Notes below (high level) — I'll prepare a redline for internal signoff:

1) SCCs / Annex on subprocessors
- Acceptable subject to: (a) we maintain a published subprocessor list and provide 30 days' notice for onboarding new subprocessors; (b) we exclude low-level infra changes from re-notification (standard carve).

2) Transfer addendum / onshore-only routing
- Operationally feasible but requires explicit Order Form pricing (capacity + egress) and a technical cutover plan. Recommend adding a Transfer Addendum Exhibit that enumerates regions and escalation path.

3) Audit scope
- We should push back on language permitting "unfettered on-site audits". Counter-proposal: scoped audits limited to data handling security controls (SOC 2 evidence + access to audit logs) and a documented technical witness option under NDA. Provide a portal evidence pack monthly.

4) Model training & use of data
- ClearWave's redline contains a clause with broad rights to use data. We must confirm whether ClearWave expects training on Redwood-hosted models. If they do, that is a deal-breaker unless explicit opt-in and compensation. Propose explicit clause: "Customer data will not be used to improve Redwood models unless agreed in writing."

5) KMS / BYOK
- Technical feasibility: BYOK available on Dedicated and Private. Hosted: customer-managed keys possible via KMS integrations but some features (streaming across multi-tenant endpoints) will be limited. We'll add a short tech note in the exhibit.

Action items:
- I'll produce an internal redline (Redwood_DPA_response_draft.docx) with the language above by EOD today.
- Ben: confirm pricing/ops delta for the onshore-only routing and whether procurement needs any additional documentation.
- Olga: please prepare the standard evidence pack + sample SOC 2 excerpt to attach.

Once we have internal agreement, David — please send a short coordinated response to ClearWave with an offer: (1) our redline, (2) proposed transfer exhibit, (3) proposed call for technical handoff.

Laura Bennett
Associate General Counsel, Redwood Inference

Emma — thanks for the patience. On behalf of Redwood legal and contracts, please find our coordinated position and next steps below. I've attached Redwood_Redline_v2.docx with inline edits and a short Transfer Exhibit draft.

Summary of position (high level):
- SCCs: we can accept the revised SCCs with an Annex as long as Redwood publishes a subprocessor list and provides 30 days' notice for changes. We've captured that language in the redline.
- Transfer addendum / onshore-only routing: operationally possible. We propose an explicit Transfer Exhibit that lists the onshore routing options available and the associated pricing. We'd like to confirm which datasets require onshore routing (full EU patient data vs. subset).
- Audit: cannot accept open-ended on-site audits. Counter-proposal: scoped audit rights limited to security controls relevant to the service, monthly portal evidence (logs/patch cadence), and the option for a technical witness under NDA.
- Model training: Redwood will not use Customer data to train foundation models unless there is a separate written agreement (explicit opt-in + commercial terms).
- KMS/BYOK: BYOK supported on Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted can support customer-managed keys via an integration but with limitations noted in the exhibit.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
1) ClearWave reviews Redwood_Redline_v2.docx and confirms whether the Transfer Exhibit scope (regions + datasets) is acceptable — by EOD Mon, 3 Jun.
2) If accepted, procurement pricing delta from Ben by Wed, 5 Jun and final Order Form issued.
3) Legal signoff (both parties) and DocuSign execution target: 7–9 Jun.

Can we schedule a short (30m) technical/legal call on Tue, 1 Jun at 10:00 BST to walk the Transfer Exhibit and KMS details? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.
